design_philosophy: Approachability, trust, and organic warmth. Reflecting a local Indonesian offline store with a modern, clean, premium e-commerce layer. Utilizing soft edges, warm earthy tones, clear typography, and bento-style layouts.

layout_spacing.grid_product: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6

homepage.hero_carousel: Use Shadcn Carousel with 'embla-carousel-autoplay' for the 3-slide auto-scrolling offline store photos. The container should be soft-rounded (rounded-3xl) with a subtle dark overlay (bg-black/30) to ensure text contrast.
homepage.cta: Prominent 'Belanja Sekarang' button overlaying the hero section or immediately below it, using the primary color.
homepage.maps_section: Embedded Google map showing the physical store. Use an iframe within a card (rounded-2xl) alongside store details.

shopping_page.filters: Horizontal scrollable pill list or sidebar with checkboxes for product types/categories.
shopping_page.product_card: Bento-style card: Image on top (aspect-square, object-cover), name, price, distinct discount badge overlay if applicable, and a primary-colored 'Beli' or 'Keranjang' button. Apply soft shadow and hover effect.

cart_checkout.layout: Two-column layout on desktop: Cart items list on the left, summary and discount input on the right.
cart_checkout.actions: Discount code input field with an 'Apply' button. Checkout button MUST be vibrant green (success_whatsapp) with a WhatsApp icon from lucide-react.

admin_dashboard.style: Clean, dense table layouts. Functional-first. White backgrounds, minimal borders. Utilize Shadcn Table, Dialog, and Forms for adding/editing products.
admin_dashboard.features: Must include functionality to upload/change the 3 slider photos, manage categories, and add discount codes with percentages when adding products.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts: 'Outfit' (for headings) and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (for body). Update tailwind.config.js to use them.
Implement the homepage slider using Shadcn Carousel + Embla Autoplay. Seed the database/state with the 'store_carousel_images' provided here, as the admin needs the ability to update them.

For the Google Maps embed, use the standard iframe format. If the provided shortlink (https://maps.app.goo.gl/ujmyhaeKVCEXRX717) cannot be embedded directly, extract or use a generic maps iframe embed pointing to the store coordinates.
Implement checkout redirect to WhatsApp formatting the cart details into the URL: 'https://wa.me/<number>?text=<encoded_order_details>'.
CRITICAL: Every interactive and key informational element MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'data-testid="belanja-sekarang-btn"').
Admin dashboard must be built using Shadcn UI components heavily. Ensure form inputs allow adding a discount code and percentage per product.
Mock the backend API logic for products, categories, cart, discounts, and slider images using state or a local mock database.
